memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'This is My body, given for you.'

sequence.prompt: What happened at the last supper? Put it in order.

items.label: They sat down to the Passover meal

matches.prompt: Match each part of the meal to what it means.

pairs.right: It remembered the lamb in Egypt

application.question: Christians still share this meal to remember Jesus. What helps you remember Him?
application.followUp: For hundreds of years that meal looked backwards to a lamb in Egypt. Jesus told His friends it had always been looking forwards — to Him. He is the Lamb, and His body was given for you.
